parameters.code: var r = UnityEngine.Object.FindAnyObjectByType<SBGames.Testing.BattleSimulationTestRunner>(); var rows = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(); rows.Add("runs="+r.UnprimedRunsCompleted+" elapsed="+r.ElapsedTime); foreach (var m in r.Monsters) if (m.Stats != null) rows.Add(m.GameObject.name+" damage="+m.Stats.Damage.Value+" life="+m.MaxLife+" aiActive="+m.AI.gameObject.activeInHierarchy); foreach (var a in r.Adventurers) rows.Add(a.SourceSlot.slotLabel+" damageTaken="+a.DamageTaken+" casts="+a.HealsCast); return rows.ToArray();
